source_refs.note: 3- Population Density: a main subheading of Demography: Characteristics of Populations, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 236-237.

blocks.text: Population density fi unit raqba (area) ya hajm (volume) afraad ki tadaad hai. Maslan Muzaffarabad mein fi murabba kilometer shehtoot (mulberry) ke darakhton ki tadaad, ya test tube mein fi milliliter E. coli bacteria ki tadaad. Zyada density wali populations mein, jab population apni carrying capacity ke qareeb pohanchti hai, to wasail ke liye muqabla (competition) bohat sakht ho sakta hai; is se paidaish ki sharah kam aur maut ka khatra zyada ho jata hai. Zyada population density se aaloodgi (pollution) bhi barh sakti hai.
